pr_title: Convert branch table name column to a new collation for mysql/mssql to support case sensitive because branch names are case sensitive
pr_body:
Git branch names are case sensitive. Since #22743 introduced branch name in database and mysql/mssql default collation are case insensitive, this PR converts the column to a case sensitive collation.

Fixes: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/25909
pr_comments: Might be good to add a test of a repo migration when case-differing branch name, e.g. `Foo` and `foo`.
->  Make table column branch.name case sensitive #28633
